verdict.rationale: DPMA runs online services: register search, DEPATISnet, and the DPMAdirektWeb/DPMAdirektPro e-filing routes. A buyer could reasonably ask whether such a service issues scoped API credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an API, API keys, tokens or permission scoping. The only access credential mentioned is the signature card used for human e-filing in DPMAdirektPro, which is not a scoped credential for an agent.
